calcium.kind: New descriptive errors calculated from archived, already-exposed model and animal summaries
calcium.retention_unit: 10 s response divided by the transition peak, source-normalized fluorescence
limits: Archived H4 body, not the qh1 delay experiment and not a new simulation.
No paired delay arms exist in this input, so these errors identify no delay effect.
Conditions are repeated measurements of one model connectome, not independent animals; no p value or confidence interval is calculated from them.
Error is against animal medians in the saved reader; raw fluorescence time-course error is a separate pending calculation.
Normalization by the transition peak hides absolute response amplitude; report both when raw matched traces are available.
L2 direction is contested in the source. Retain that qualification and do not promote this scalar error into a biological pass/fail.
L1 readout depends on lag and release-law settings; the active group is fitting this dataset, so it is development evidence.

walking.animal_protocol: isoD1 females, free walking on glass at 34 C, 150 frames/s, eight recordings
walking.comparison_status: Diagnostic side-by-side only; common observation rule required before numerical gait error
limits: The archived simulation uses tip-height hysteresis and completed-lift counts; the animal reader uses smoothed camera-plane foot velocity and complete steady cycles.
Do not subtract these gait values to claim prediction error. Resample simulated foot positions to 150 Hz and apply the source reader to both.
Archived speed is displacement after settling; animal bins use cycle-mean forward speed. Per-run bin matching is preliminary.
Trials below 0.5 mm/s are outside these extracted animal bins; no nearest-bin extrapolation is allowed.
The animal record already influenced development. Temperature and spontaneous versus DNg100-driven walking also differ.
The initial 3 Hz step selection excludes slow steady cycles; use the corrected 1 to 25 Hz steady-step extraction.
Animal uncertainty must resample recordings or verified animals, not tracked fragments. Do not use the old fly-ID bootstrap as independent-animal uncertainty.

calcium_inputs.status: Input validated; no model prediction or held-out performance computed
limits: Repeated tastants and trials share flies. Trace-condition count is not independent animal count.
Cross-record exposure audit and verified cell mapping precede any held-out claim.
Slow sampling cannot directly resolve millisecond transmission delays; any test concerns their downstream effect on calcium dynamics.
Roundup baseline differs from the stated method; exclude absolute time-course error until the baseline is reconciled.
